category_title: Students who communicate knowledge through visual and performing arts to overcome vocabulary limitations
scenario_title: Struggle with traditional written assignments due to vocabulary limitations
minimal_context: The student is using library books and reading resources to write a five-paragraph essay on a topic in the regular classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: For this assignment, you need to use the library books and reading resources to write five paragraphs on the topic.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I checked out a library book to research, but can I construct a model or a drawing for my summative instead?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: The directions say to write five paragraphs, so please focus on writing.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am trying to write, but I engage particularly well in visual activities or in the arts.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think you should write next? Keep trying.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't do it. My vocabulary is lacking if I am expected to write five paragraphs on a topic. I don't know enough words to fill it all up.
